chunks: And [he will be] as a messenger to the Children of Israel [saying], 'Indeed, I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, that I design for you from clay the figure of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allah, and I heal the blind and the leper, and I raise the dead by permission of Allah, and I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you if you are believers.'

key_terms.كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ: in the form of a bird

ai.seo_question: What were the specific miracles of Jesus (peace be upon him) mentioned in the Quran to the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the Imams' authority, as the miracle of breathing life into clay birds is often linked to the Imams' spiritual power (takhalluq) and their role as the true inheritors of Jesus' mission. The phrase 'by God's permission' (bi-idhnillah) underscores their dependent status, distinguishing their miraculous acts from divine essence while affirming their unique connection to the Divine Will. This serves as a theological foundation for the concept of 'Hujjah' (proof), where the Imam manifests divine signs to guide the faithful.
